description: This Java class, WidgetDataResourceWorker, is a utility class responsible for dynamically loading and providing access to an implementation of DataResourceWorkerInterface. It uses reflection to load a class at runtime, handles potential class loading exceptions, and provides a static method to retrieve the loaded worker instance.

classes.name: WidgetDataResourceWorker
classes.description: A final utility class that uses reflection to load and provide access to a DataResourceWorkerInterface implementation.

methods.name: getDataresourceWorker
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of DataResourceWorkerInterface that was loaded dynamically during class initialization.
